note: Voix des personnages (tools/voices/make_voices.py). kokoro = voix de référence synthétique (Kokoro-82M, Apache 2.0) ; ref_semitones = décalage de hauteur de la référence (identité plus grave ou plus aiguë) ; exaggeration, cfg, temperature = réglages de Chatterbox Multilingual (MIT) : expressivité, fidélité au texte, variété ; ref = phrase dite par la voix de référence.

callahan.ref: Listen up, you sorry bunch. We hold this theater, we hit them hard, and nobody gets left behind. Now grab a gun and let's go to work!

orlov.ref: Snow, mud, blood. It is always the same winter. The dead walk, and still we must stand. Very well. Give me bread, give me bullets, and I will stand.

arakawa.ref: The river does not hurry, yet it carves the mountain. Stay calm, keep your aim true, and we shall leave this place with honor.

weissmann.ref: Marvelous! Simply marvelous! Do you see how they twitch? My machines are awake, my children are hungry, and the experiment has only just begun!
